mapper.sql: a.id, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.content, a.article_type, a.status, a.view_count, a.deleted, a.published_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.price, a.unit, a.sales_text, a.product_tags, a.farmer_name, a.farmer_phone, a.origin_place, a.recommended
mapper.select: SELECT FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_article(category_id, title, summary, cover_image, content, article_type, status, published_at, price, unit, sales_text, product_tags, farmer_name, farmer_phone, origin_place, recommended) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{coverImage}, #{content}, #{articleType}, #{status}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, #{price}, #{unit}, #{salesText}, #{productTags}, #{farmerName}, #{farmerPhone}, #{originPlace}, #{recommended})
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_article SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, content = #{content}, article_type = #{articleType}, status = #{status}, price = #{price}, unit = #{unit}, sales_text = #{salesText}, product_tags = #{productTags}, farmer_name = #{farmerName}, farmer_phone = #{farmerPhone}, origin_place = #{originPlace}, recommended = #{recommended}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 AND published_at IS NULL THEN NOW() WHEN #{status} = 1 THEN published_at ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE blog_article SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
